articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Reshapes Platform With CyberArk Deal And Tel Aviv Listing
articles.mainIdea: Palo Alto Networks Reshapes Platform With CyberArk Deal And Tel Aviv Listing
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Palo Alto Networks Reshapes Platform With CyberArk Deal And Tel Aviv Listing. Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS:PANW) has completed its $25b acquisition of identity security firm CyberArk. The company has begun a dual listing on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, adding to its existing Nasdaq listing. Palo Alto Networks also moved to expand into new security markets with the acquisition of observability platform Chronosphere.
